rationale: I read the held original of EO 10955 (26 FR 6967, fr-originals text) in full and confirmed identity by heading, number, date (July 31, 1961) and Kennedy signature: sec. 1 delegates the functions under sections 2 and 3 of the Act of September 8, 1960 to the Secretary of State and sec. 2 deems the appropriated funds allocated to him, with no own-terms end. The held official text of EO 10973 (26 FR 10469) sec. 605(c) supersedes 'Executive Order No. 10955 of July 31, 1961 (26 F.R. 6967)' with no exception, sec. 607 makes the order effective as of September 30, 1961, sec. 101 re-delegates the same Latin America act functions to the Secretary, and sec. 606 saves only prior actions, so the supersession reaches the whole order and nothing of it survives as a continuing command. A cruden number search of the held order texts found only EO 10973 and the original naming EO 10955, so no earlier end exists; the status no is supported by held sources through 2026-10-14.
